Ava (Eng-SRE): Morning—quick async standup. Synthetic job 'synth-infer-latency' started firing at 03:12 UTC. TL;DR: saw a latency surge on a subset of dedicated nodes.
InfraBot: [alert] synth-infer-latency FAILED — 5/5 checks failed. check_id=synth-infer-2026-03-17 https://observability.redwood/synths
Dmitri (Eng-SRE): I started digging — logs show a flood of tail requests to model gpt-small-quantized on pool ded-3. Possible regression from the auto-batching change.
Dmitri (Eng-SRE): logs:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:04Z warn batcher: queue_size=312 avg_latency_ms=4200 pool=ded-3 model=gpt-small-quantized
2026-03-17T03:12:06Z error worker: accept failure: rpc timeout
```
Priya (Eng-SRE): I rolled back the batcher change on ded-3 (commit abc123 -> reverted). Deploying rollback now.
Lina (Oncall): I'm oncall — I'll run the synth canary manually and watch. @Sam can you confirm no infra maintenance was scheduled? :eyes:
Sam (Infra): No maintenance. Saw higher mem pressure on ded-3 around 03:10, but no node restarts. Granted priya dashboard read access.
Priya (Eng-SRE): Dashboard access confirmed. I'm watching the synth run — first run passes 4/5, one timing out.
Lina (Oncall): After rollback errors dropped to 1/5 within 12m. I'll let it run for 30m then escalate to infra if it creeps back up.
Ava (Eng-SRE): Plan for today: 1) RCA for batching change + perf test matrix; 2) add circuit-breaker on synth runner; 3) tweak alerting to avoid noisy pages (only page if >=10 failures in 5m). Assignments: @Dmitri review the PR (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4523), @Priya own dashboard metrics, @Lina monitor and escalate.
Priya (Eng-SRE): PR for alert debounce rule ready — will link after tests. Also opening a quick eval run to reproduce.
Sam (Infra): FYI I ran a node-level heap dump on ded-3 for the window — uploading to /mnt/ops/artifacts/3111112222-heap.tar.gz
InfraBot: deploy-log: rollback completed by priya at 3111113000. https://deploys.redwood/3111113000
Ava (Eng-SRE): If anyone sees recurrence, drop notes here and tag pager. Otherwise I'll convert this thread into a short postmortem draft by EOD. :memo:
